verdict.rationale: Portkey documents a first-party Model Catalog, described as a single pane to view and manage every provider and model with discovery, covering 1,600+ models. That covers the browse part of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows the catalog exposes per-model pricing or context-window metadata, or that it can be queried programmatically through an API. missing for 10: pricing metadata per model, context-window metadata per model, a documented API or endpoint for querying the catalog, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can browse or query a catalog of available models with pricing and context-window metadata

citations.quote: A single pane to view and manage every AI provider and model in your organization. It provides centralized governance, discovery, and usage controls for all your AI resources.
Use Portkey’s Model Catalog to manage access to 1,600+ models across your organization centrally.
